'''Teresa Rodrigo Anoro''' (1956{{spnd}}21 April 2020) was a Spanish scientist who worked in [[particle physics]]. She worked at [[CERN]], [[Fermilab]] and the {{ill|Instituto de Física de Cantabria|es}} and was professor at the [[University of Cantabria]]. Whilst at CERN, Rodrigo worked on the [[Compact Muon Solenoid]] and research for the [[Higgs boson]].

==Career==
In 1994, Rodrigo became a professor of [[atomic physics]] at the [[University of Cantabria]].<ref name=EE>{{cite news| url= https://www.elespanol.com/ciencia/investigacion/20200421/muere-teresa-rodrigo-madre-espanola-boson-higgs/484202997_0.html| title= Muere Teresa Rodrigo, la 'madre española' del bosón de Higgs| language=es| work=[[El Español]]| date=21 April 2020| access-date=7 December 2020}}</ref> Rodrigo also worked at the {{ill|Instituto de Física de Cantabria|es}} (IFCA) and [[Fermilab]] in the US.<ref name=EDM /> She worked on the [[Collider Detector at Fermilab]] experiment that discovered the [[top quark]] in 1995.<ref name=EE /><ref name=20Min /><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Cabrera|first1=S|last2=Fernández|first2=J|last3=Gómez|first3=G|last4=Piedra|first4=J|last5=Rodrigo|first5=T|last6=Ruiz|first6=A|last7=Vila|first7=I|last8=Vilar|first8=R|last9=Grozis|first9=C|last10=Kephart|first10=R|last11=Stanek|first11=R|date=2002|title=The CDF-II time-of-flight detector|url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0168900202015127|journal=Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research Section A: Accelerators, Spectrometers, Detectors and Associated Equipment|language=en|volume=494|issue=1–3|pages=416–423|doi=10.1016/S0168-9002(02)01512-7|bibcode=2002NIMPA.494..416C|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=CDF Collaboration|last2=Abulencia|first2=A.|last3=Acosta|first3=D.|last4=Adelman|first4=J.|last5=Affolder|first5=T.|last6=Akimoto|first6=T.|last7=Albrow|first7=M. G.|last8=Ambrose|first8=D.|last9=Amerio|first9=S.|last10=Amidei|first10=D.|last11=Anastassov|first11=A.|date=25 August 2006|title=Measurement of the t Production Cross Section in pp Collisions at √s=1.96 TeV|url=https://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/PhysRevLett.97.082004|journal=Physical Review Letters|volume=97|issue=8|article-number=082004|doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.97.082004| arxiv=hep-ex/0606017|pmid=17026295|hdl=1969.1/181538|s2cid=118993472 |hdl-access=free}}</ref>

From 2016 to 2019, Rodrigo was a director of IFCA.<ref name=EDM /> She was the sixth director of IFCA, and the first female director.<ref name=Gallo>{{cite news| url=https://elgallodigital.com/teresa-rodrigo-nueva-directora-del-instituto-fisica-cantabria/| title=Teresa Rodrigo, nueva directora del Instituto de Física de Cantabria| language=es| work=El Gallo| date=2016| access-date=7 December 2020| archive-date=25 April 2020| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200425021341/https://elgallodigital.com/teresa-rodrigo-nueva-directora-del-instituto-fisica-cantabria/}}</ref> Rodrigo also collaborated on the [[European Strategy for Particle Physics]].<ref name=Pais>{{cite news| url= https://elpais.com/ciencia/2020-04-24/teresa-rodrigo-un-referente-de-la-ciencia-espanola.html| title= Teresa Rodrigo, un referente de la ciencia española| language=es| work=[[El País]]| date=24 April 2020| access-date=7 December 2020}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2014, Rodrigo was named one of the 100 most influential women in Spain by website Mujeresycia.com.<ref name=Muj>{{cite web| url= https://mujeresycia.com/muere-teresa-rodrigo-cientifica-top-100-y-madre-espanola-del-boson-de-higgs/| title= Muere Teresa Rodrigo, científica, Top 100 y "madre española" del bosón de Higgs| language=es| publisher=Mujeresycia.com| date=27 April 2020| access-date=7 December 2020}}</ref> In 2016, Rodrigo received the ''Julio Peláez Prize for Pioneers of Physical, Chemical and Mathematical Sciences'' for her work on the discovery of the Higgs boson.<ref>{{cite web| url=https://fundaciontatianapgb.org/teresa-rodrigo-recibe-premio-julio-pelaez-pioneras-las-ciencias-fisicas-quimicas-matematicas-otorga-la-fundacion/| title=Teresa Rodrigo recibe el "Premio Julio Peláez a Pioneras de las Ciencias Físicas, Químicas y Matemáticas" que otorga la fundación| language=es| publisher=Fundación Tatiana Pérez de Guzmán el Bueno| date=8 September 2016| access-date=7 December 2020}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

==Personal life==
Rodrigo was born in [[Lleida]], Spain.<ref name=EDM>{{cite news| url= https://www.eldiariomontanes.es/cantabria/muere-teresa-rodrigo-20200421190740-nt.html| title= Fallece Teresa Rodrigo, científica pionera y experta mundial en física de partículas| language=es| work=[[El Diario Montañés]]| date=21 April 2020| access-date=7 December 2020}}</ref> She studied at the [[University of Zaragoza]], and earned a [[PhD]] from '' La Junta de Energía Nuclear'' (now [[CIEMAT]]).<ref name=CERN/><ref name=Pais/>

Rodrigo died on 21 April 2020 in [[Santander, Spain]].<ref name=EDM/>
